stories.title: Diagnose and reduce end-user home page initial load latency

focus_hints: slow image/render blocking on first paint

requirements: First diagnose the main contributors to slow initial load.
Then implement only narrow changes that improve initial load time.
Do not change visible UX unless necessary.
Do not change unrelated pages or systems.
Prefer reducing duplicate fetches, unnecessary effects, oversized payloads, and blocking work on first render.
acceptance_criteria: Home page behavior remains functionally correct.
Implemented changes are limited and performance-focused.
